{{Quote|All units, this is Grand Moff Tarkin. We have detected an enemy carrier shifting into realspace from lightspeed in Sector Seven, at two thousand, two hundred kilometers' distance from the station, repeat, enemy carrier in Sector Seven. The vessel is identified as the ''Fortressa'', a ''Lucre-hulk''-class carrier. Star Destroyers are moving to engage, but we expect the enemy to launch fighters. They pose a risk to the station. Stop them.|[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]|<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
'''Sector Seven''' was a region of space surrounding [[Despayre]] where the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] was being constructed. The [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class carrier]] ''[[Fortressa]]'' emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in this sector and headed straight for the Death Star which was 2200 km away, starting an [[Attack on the first Death Star|attack on the Death Star]].
